comment: Methylation of Fusicoccin Q to give Fusicoccin P and related terpenoid intermediates.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 revised SMARTS/SMILES, added side reactions observed in vitro, added cofactor information.

reactions.description: O-methylation of fusicoccin terpene scaffold to yield methylated derivatives.
Methylation of fusicoccin Q to yield fusicoccin P, intermediate in the biosynthetic patwhay of fusicoccin A. Could not be demonstrated in vitro due to unavaialability of substrate, inferred.
Methylation of fusicoccin H aglycon to 16-O-methyl derivative, observed in vitro in trace amounts.
Methylation of fusicoccin H to yield 16-O-methyl-fusicoccin H, observed in vitro but not main step of the biosynthetic pathway.

evidenceCode: Inference from genomic data and chemical structure
